title: Frozen build copy
responsibility: Copies a completed build and checks that source and destination retain the same build identity.

inputs.name: frozenBuild.copied
inputs.description: Optional async copy operation, defaulting to recursive filesystem copy.

outputs.name: frozenBuild
outputs.description: Target directory, source build identifier and file count after matching the source-before, source-after and copied identities.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws if the source has no build or identities differ; a mismatch removes the target. Identity, filesystem and copy failures can also reject.
